# Flick

> A stupidly-fast PHP form builder.

## Philosophy

Flick prioritizes developer speed and simplicity:
- Easy to type - Short method names, minimal keystrokes
- Easy to remember - Intuitive APIs, no hunting through docs
- Seconds to production - Install and create forms immediately

## Installation

```shell
composer require flickphp/flick
```

## Quick Start

### Simplest Form (String Syntax)

```php
$form = new Flick\Flick();
echo $form->create('Name, Email, Comments|textarea');
```

This generates a complete form with:
- CSRF protection
- Form wrapper and submit button
- Field names auto-generated from labels (Name → name, Email → email, E-mail → e_mail)

### With Validation

```php
$form->create('
    Name[required, min:3],
    Email[required, email],
    Password[required, strongPassword],
    Confirm Password[required, matches:password]
');
```

### Processing Submissions

```php
if ($form->submitted()) {
    $data = $form->request('
        Name[required],
        Email[required, email]
    ');

    if ($form->ok()) {
        // Validation passed
        echo $data['name'];
        echo $data['email'];
    }
    // Errors auto-display on form re-render
}
```

## Constructor Options

```php
$form = new Flick\Flick([
    'id' => 'myForm',           // Form ID
    'views' => 'bootstrap',     // CSS: flick, bootstrap, tailwind, bulma, foundation, materialize
    'action' => '/submit',      // Form action URL
    'csrf' => true,             // CSRF protection (default: true)
    'session' => false,         // Persist values in session
    'honeypot' => 'website',    // Spam protection field name
    'trustedProxies' => ['10.0.0.0/8'], // Proxies whose forwarded headers are honored (IPs/CIDR/'*'; [] = none; unset = private/loopback peers)
]);
```

## String Syntax Reference

Format: Label|type[rules]{default}

Examples:
- Name                          → text input, name="name"
- Email|email                   → email input
- Bio|textarea                  → textarea
- Country|select(countries)     → dropdown with prebuilt countries
- Role|select([admin:Admin, editor:Editor]::Choose...)[required] → dropdown with placeholder
- Newsletter|checkbox           → checkbox
- Photo|file                    → file upload
- Name{John}                    → text with default value "John"
- Email[required, email]        → with validation rules

## Field Element Methods

All methods: methodName($name, $label = '', $value = '', $attributes = [])
Exceptions: hidden($name, $value); datalist($name, $label, $value, $options, $attributes)

Text inputs: text(), email(), password(), number(), tel(), url(), search(), color(), range()
Date/time: date(), datetime(), time(), month(), week()
Selection: select(), selectMultiple(), checkbox(), checkboxInline(), radio(), radioInline()
Other: textarea(), file(), files(), hidden(), datalist()
Structure: open(), close(), openMultipart(), fieldsetOpen(), fieldsetClose(), submit()

## Validation Rules

### Common Rules
- required, r              Field must have value
- email                    Valid email format
- min:N, max:N            Character length limits
- strongPassword          8+ chars, upper, lower, digit, special
- strongPassword:N        Custom minimum length
- confirmed               Must match {field}_confirmation
- matches:field           Must match another field
- in:a,b,c                Must be one of listed values
- regex:/pattern/         Match regex pattern

### Numeric Rules
- int, numeric            Number validation
- between:M,N             Value between M and N
- greaterThan:N           Value > N
- lessThan:N              Value < N

### Date Rules
- after:date              After date (supports: today, tomorrow, 2024-01-01)
- before:date             Before date
- afterOrEqual:date       After or equal to date

### Format Rules
- url                     Valid URL
- phone                   Valid phone (10-16 digits)
- creditCard              Valid credit card (Luhn)
- uuid                    Valid UUID v4
- ip, ipv4, ipv6          IP address

### String Modifiers (Applied After Validation)
Input is trimmed of surrounding whitespace BEFORE rules run (password and
password_confirmation exempt); 'trim' => false in the config disables it.
Modifiers below change only the returned value.

- bcrypt, hash            Hash with bcrypt
- slug                    Convert to URL slug
- sanitizeChars           Escape HTML entities
- stripTags               Remove HTML tags

### Custom Error Messages

```php
$form->request('Email[required, email][required:Email is required, email:Invalid email]');
```

## Multistep Forms

Define steps as an array; Flick handles navigation, per-step validation (each field's rules run before the step advances), a review page, and session state. Requires an active session.

```php
$steps = [
    'Contact' => ['fields' => [
        'name'  => ['label' => 'Name', 'rules' => ['required']],
        'email' => ['type' => 'email', 'label' => 'Email', 'rules' => ['required', 'email']],
    ]],
    'Details' => ['fields' => [
        'bio' => ['type' => 'textarea', 'label' => 'Bio'],
    ]],
];

if ($form->multistepIsComplete()) {
    $data = $form->multistepFormData(); // returns data and clears the ENTIRE Flick session
    // process $data, then redirect or return — don't fall through to createMultistep()
    return;
}

$form->createMultistep($steps);
```

Options (2nd arg to createMultistep): auto (bool, default true), nextText, reviewTitle, reviewText, submitText
Helpers: multistepFormData($clear = true) — pass false to keep the session; multistepReviewData() — read without clearing; multistepCurrentStep($steps); multistepSteps($steps); multistepCompletedSteps(); multistepIsInReview(); multistepBreadcrumbs($steps); submitMultistep($text)

## Pro Services

Install: `composer require flickphp/pro` (requires a license and the Flick Pro repository entry in composer.json — see https://flickphp.com/pro for setup)

Access services via magic property: `$form->serviceName`

### SQL Service

```php
// CRUD
$id = $form->sql->save('users', ['name' => 'John', 'email' => 'john@example.com']);
$user = $form->sql->find('users', $id);
$form->sql->delete('users', $id);

// Query builder
$users = $form->sql->table('users')
    ->where('active', 1)
    ->orderBy('created_at', 'DESC')
    ->limit(10)
    ->get();

// Check uniqueness
if (!$form->sql->validateUnique('users', 'email', $email)) {
    $form->addError('email', 'Email taken');
}
```

### Mail Service

```php
$form->mail->send('user@example.com', 'Subject', 'Body');

// With template and data
$form->mail->send($to, $subject, $plaintext, [
    'data' => ['name' => 'John', 'message' => 'Welcome!']
]);

// Send form data as email
$form->mail->sendFormData('admin@example.com', 'New Submission', $data);

// Attachments
$form->mail->attach('/path/file.pdf')->send($to, $subject, $body);
```

### Upload Service

```php
// Image with processing
$file = $form->upload->image('photo', ['maxFileSize:5MB']);
if ($file) {
    echo $file->url;              // FileInfo (no conversions configured)
    // With conversions configured, image() returns a FileCollection:
    // echo $file->original->url;
    // echo $file->thumbnail->url;
}

// Generic file
$file = $form->upload->file('document', ['required']);
```

### Auth Service

```php
$form->auth->login($userId, $remember = false);
$form->auth->logout();

if ($form->auth->check()) {
    $userId = $form->auth->id();
}

$hash = $form->auth->hash($password);
$valid = $form->auth->verify($password, $hash);
```

### Validation Service (Client-Side)

```php
// Auto-generates JavaScript validation matching server rules
echo $form->validation->scripts($form->getFields());
```

## Complete Examples

### Contact Form

```php
$form = new Flick\Flick(['views' => 'tailwind']);

if ($form->submitted()) {
    $data = $form->request('Name[required], Email[required, email], Message[required, min:10]');

    if ($form->ok()) {
        $form->mail->sendFormData('admin@example.com', 'Contact Form', $data);
        $form->successMessage('Thanks! We will reply soon.');
    }
}

echo $form->create('Name, Email, Message|textarea');
```

### User Registration

```php
if ($form->submitted()) {
    $data = $form->request('
        Name[required],
        Email[required, email],
        Password[required, strongPassword, confirmed]
    ');

    if (!$form->sql->validateUnique('users', 'email', $data['email'])) {
        $form->addError('email', 'Email already registered');
    }

    if ($form->ok()) {
        $form->sql->save('users', [
            'name' => $data['name'],
            'email' => $data['email'],
            'password' => password_hash($data['password'], PASSWORD_BCRYPT)
        ]);
        $form->successMessage('Account created!');
    }
}

echo $form->create('Name, Email, Password|password, Confirm Password|password');
```

## Gotchas

1. Always check $form->ok() after $form->request() - validation errors don't throw
2. $form->request() both validates AND returns data - don't call twice
3. Field names auto-generated from labels: "Full Name" → "full_name", "E-mail" → "e_mail" (spaces and hyphens both become underscores)
4. CSRF is enabled by default - disable with 'csrf' => false if needed
5. Services lazy-load - $form->mail only loads mail service when accessed
6. String syntax pipes: Name|type not Name | type (no spaces around pipe)
7. For file uploads, use $form->openMultipart() or 'enctype' => 'multipart/form-data'

## Configuration

- Config array passed to constructor
- Pro services configured under 'services' key
- CSS framework set via 'views' option
- 'trim' => false disables pre-validation whitespace trimming

## Resources

- Documentation: https://flickphp.com
